description: Ranked sources one answer engine cites, by that engine's citation rate across the whole window. Pass category to limit the list to sources with a published segment in that category; the rate stays the whole-window rate and is not a rate inside the category. Collecting categories and engines below the evidence floor withhold the ranking. Use to answer 'what sources does Perplexity cite most?' or 'which sources does Google AI Overviews cite among published <category> sources'.

category.description: Optional category key. Limits the ranking to sources with a published segment in that category.

cursor.description: Page token from the previous response's next.cursor. When set, offset is ignored.

engine.description: Engine key from mri_list_engines: chatgpt, claude, gemini, google_ai_mode, google_ai_overviews, perplexity.

name: mri_get_engine
title: Sources one answer engine cites
